# Vendored libraries

Kept here instead of loaded from a CDN: the pages hold the car pairing keys, so no third-party
server gets to change their code.

| File | Library | Version | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jsQR-1.4.0.js` | [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) (QR code decoding for the in-page scanner, used where the browser has no `BarcodeDetector`, e.g. Safari) | 1.4.0 | Apache-2.0 ([`jsQR-LICENSE.txt`](jsQR-LICENSE.txt)) | `dist/jsQR.js` of the npm tarball `jsqr-1.4.0.tgz`, integrity `sha512-dxLob7q65Xg2DvstYkRpkYtmKm2sPJ9oFhrhmudT1dZvNFFTlroai3AWSpLey/w5vMcLBXRgOJsbXpdN9HzU/A==`, unmodified |
